steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen for an auction.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the auction pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product so the auction has a bid row.
Invite the vendor who will submit and revise the bid.
Publish the auction so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Submit the vendor's initial bid of 100.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the vendor's revised bid of 90, establishing a 10% reduction from the previous bid.
Confirm the revised vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's Auction Responses comparison.
Verify the displayed savings percentage matches the reduction from 100 to 90.
